_doc: The edit list for web/tools/film-cut.mjs. Segments play in order; a segment marked optional is skipped when its source file is absent.
frames: a frame set dumped by web/tools/film-dump.mjs into film/frames/<aspect>-<set>/ (from inclusive, to exclusive, at 24 fps).
still and seq: page shots from web/tools/film-shots.mjs in film/frames/stills/<aspect>/ (a PNG, or a folder of numbered PNGs).
wipe: two frame sets of one camera path (ink and ?ink=off); the divider is the share of the width showing b, moving from 'from' to 'to' between t0 and t1.
Captions: t0 and t1 in seconds from the segment's start; 'label' is the small line above the words. Every claim is from LOG.md or THESIS.md.
No sound: the film has no audio track until Aaron's own music (film/README.md).
title: Here Be Ink

captions.label: Here Be Ink
captions.text: A pen line crosses the floor of a real room.

captions.label: Here Be Ink
captions.text: On this side a camera measured. Past it, a model imagined.

captions.label: The page
captions.text: The first screen states the rule. It doesn't say where the line falls.

captions.label: Measured
captions.text: My room, filmed in three slow passes with a 360 camera.

captions.label: Measured
captions.text: Where it looks like a photograph, the camera saw it.

captions.label: The coastline
captions.text: At the door frame the measuring stops. Past the line, it is ink.

captions.label: Imagined
captions.text: World Labs' Marble built this hallway from one 360 still.

captions.label: Looking back
captions.text: Turn round, and the room is still a photograph.

captions.label: In a headset
captions.text: The same walk on a Quest.

captions.label: The map
captions.text: From above: photograph, drawing, and grey where nothing was scanned.

captions.label: The switch
captions.text: The same view near the door, in ink.

captions.label: The finding
captions.text: The filter shows what Marble made: a door at the end, a picture, a skirting board.

captions.label: The finding
captions.text: The ink keeps none of it, just one even cross-hatch. It reads as a filter, not a drawing.

captions.label: What it suggests
captions.text: Still, the border holds. A caption won't survive a screenshot; a way of drawing can.

captions.label: What it suggests
captions.text: One test, not a proof: a made-up world can carry its provenance in how it is drawn.

end.title: Here Be Ink
end.sub: photograph where the camera measured, ink where a model imagined
credits: Imagined half generated with World Labs Marble (marble-1.1-plus) through the World API; drawn in ink by the page.
Measured half: a 360 camera, COLMAP and LichtFeld Studio. Rendered with Spark.
